verdict.rationale: Termius documents SFTP file transfer with a dual-pane interface and one-click switching between terminal and SFTP sessions on the same host, using the same configured Hosts/Keychain credentials, plus a keychain for SSH key management with passphrase protection referenced across connections. This directly covers scp/sftp-style file transfer using configured keys. Missing for 10: explicit mention of the `scp` command/protocol specifically (only SFTP is named) and independent hands-on corroboration of file-transfer reliability.
